title: Register as a greyhound racing industry participant
what: Register before carrying on any activity as a greyhound racing industry participant (owners, trainers, breeders and others).

sources.title: Greyhound Racing Act 2017 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on any activity as a greyhound racing industry participant unless the person is registered to carry on that activity.
